function.name: run_test_suite
function.description: Execute a test suite or a standalone test script safely inside the sandbox. Captures traceback and stderr on failure so you can fix errors and retry (TDD loop). Features an automatic max-retry interrupt to hand control back to human if tests fail continuously.

test_target.description: Path to the test file or directory, e.g., 'tests/test_math.py'

framework.description: The framework to use. 'pytest' is recommended. If it's a simple assert script, use 'python'.
